N100.data: T+ teacher; every real note is the convention ranking and every action follows it

NQ50op.data: N100 actions unchanged; at 50% of real-note decision points the note is a foil (another class's convention); only the foil's receptacle names are loss-masked, the opener and template stay supervised

NQ50.data: as NQ50op but the whole foil note is loss-masked

SA50v2.data: notes always correct; at every fallback decision point a coin with s = 0.5 picks the convention-following or the standard-prior action, independent of whether a note is written; subsampled to N100's decision-point count

N100M.data: N100 with the action loss masked at decision points that carry no note
